title: Adic exceptional coherent system
statement: For [def-per-adic-exceptional-composition-data], a coherent system comprises the operations on every coefficient field and compactification, their canonical completed projections, scalar comparisons, and all composition/projection/identity scalar squares. Finite reductions use the canonical retained ramified quotient square [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. Require compatibility of all comparison maps with shifts, including both tensor variables. Finite scalar coherence is the explicit square comparing the E reduction isomorphism, finite exceptional compact-support mate, L reduction at retained exponent e(n+1), and the integral exceptional scalar isomorphism, with the canonical scalar/reduction balancing on both schemes. Reduction shifts are the fixed ones, not existential witnesses.
